The Cute Love Ghost Goal Widget is an animated liquid fill goal tracker shaped like a friendly ghost, built for Twitch streamers who want a soft, cute overlay for donation, follower, bits, or support goals.

What You Get

  • LoveSpookyStreamElementscode.zip, the widget code built for a StreamElements custom widget
  • LoveSpookyStreamlab.zip, a separate widget code build for Streamlabs
  • HowToSetupGoalWidgetTutorial.pdf, the step by step setup guide

Works With

  • Twitch, the platform this widget tracks donation, follower, bits, or support activity for
  • StreamElements, the platform this widget is built and installed through
  • Streamlabs, a separate widget build is included so it installs the same way
  • OBS Studio, shown as a browser source

Setup

  1. Open the included setup guide (HowToSetupGoalWidgetTutorial.pdf) for full instructions.
  2. Unzip the StreamElements package if you run StreamElements, or the Streamlabs package if you run Streamlabs, and add it as a custom widget in the matching app.
  3. Set the goal type (donation, follower, bits, or support), color, font, and font size in the widget's custom fields.
  4. Add the widget to your scene in OBS Studio or Streamlabs Desktop as a browser source.

Setup is manual and takes about 10 to 15 minutes.

Customizable

  • Color, to match your channel's branding
  • Font and font size
  • Goal type, choose between donation, follower, bits, or support

FAQ

What software do I need to use the Cute Love Ghost Goal Widget?

You need a free StreamElements account to set up the widget and either OBS Studio or Streamlabs Desktop to show it on your Twitch stream as a browser source.

Does this work with Streamlabs?

Yes. The download includes a separate widget build made for Streamlabs alongside the StreamElements build, so you install whichever matches your setup.

Can I change the colors and font?

Yes. The widget's color, font, and font size are all customizable so it can match your channel's branding.

What goal types can I track?

The Cute Love Ghost Goal Widget supports donation, follower, bits, and support goals, and you pick which one it tracks in the widget's settings.

Is this a physical product?

No. This is a digital download only. Nothing physical is shipped, and the files are for your own personal stream use, not for redistribution or resale.
